description: This PHP source file defines the ThemeService class used for managing theme-related functionalities in the OrangeHRM system, including cache management for theme images, variables, and URLs, as well as helper methods for CSS variable derivation.

classes.name: ThemeService
classes.description: Service class for managing theme assets, variables, URLs, and cache operations related to themes in the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getThemeDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the ThemeDao instance used for database operations related to themes.

methods.name: getScssHelper
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the ScssHelper instance used for SCSS string manipulations.

methods.name: getImageETag
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag for a specified theme image key, utilizing cache or fetching fresh data if cache miss.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Fetches a ThemeImage object for a given image key, loading from cache or invoking retrieval if needed.

methods.name: getImageETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Fetches image data and its ETag, populating cache entries if blank.

methods.name: getCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Retrieves theme variables, falling back to default if custom theme is not found, and derives CSS variables.

methods.name: showSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Determines whether social media icons should be displayed based on the theme configuration.

methods.name: getDerivedCssVariables
methods.description: Generates a map of CSS variable definitions based on theme variables, including color manipulations via helper.

methods.name: getClientLogoURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the client logo, depending on cache availability.

methods.name: getClientBannerURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the client banner, depending on cache availability.

methods.name: getLoginBannerURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the login banner, depending on cache availability.
